system: You are a Python programmer. Return only the modified score function.
prompt_template:
Modify this bin-scoring function to reduce the number of bins used in online bin packing. Keep the interface score(item, bins), and output only Python code.
item is a positive float; bins is a nonempty 1D numpy float64 array of feasible remaining capacities, each >= item. Capacity is 100. The evaluator preallocates one empty bin per item, scores all feasible bins, chooses the highest score, and breaks ties by the earliest bin index. Item order is fixed.
Return a finite numpy float64 array with exactly the same shape as bins. Use one pure deterministic function with straight-line local assignments and a return. numpy is already available as np. You may import numpy as np. Use numpy vector operations; do not use loops, helper functions, randomness, I/O, external state, or modify bins. No reflections or explanation.
Parent function:
{code}
evaluator: EoH-compatible feasibility/argmax/first-index ties, synthetic fixed 64 instances; not full EoH evolution
primary_metric: Strict improvement of mean check bins versus same parent / all 24 generation attempts per parent and representation
selection_scope: Round2-result-selected eight cases; no parent population inference

bootstrap.unit: 24 paired generation seed indices within each fixed parent; no parent resampling

stopping_rule.test: One-sided exact paired McNemar/binomial discordance test; Holm over four primary directional tests; familywise alpha 0.05
stopping_rule.advance_only_if: At least one alternative family passes BOTH its selected-case and opposite-direction control tests: each Holm p<=0.05 and observed improvement-rate advantage>=0.10, with validity gate satisfied
stopping_rule.if_pass: Selected-case directional evidence justifies proposing a subsequent separately locked experiment; do not launch adaptive search in this run
stopping_rule.if_fail: Stop this confirmation after 576. Do not proceed to full adaptive search or automatically expand/reselect cases. Inconclusive does not mean no parent dependence
stopping_rule.if_invalid_gate_fails: Measurement inadequate; stop without claiming confirmation or absence

individual_tests: 11 prespecified directional paired tests: five alternative-vs-temporary cases, six temporary-vs-alternative controls. Holm across 11; secondary, cannot override primary stopping rule
